definition: to put or send something out
description: A barefoot boy in a black t-shirt and blue shorts stands on the grass at the edge of a still lake at sunset. He whips a fishing rod forward over his head and the line arcs far out across the orange water. He follows through and stands watching the line settle, silhouetted against the sky. The shot then cuts to his hands close up, holding the rod and a silver reel wound with turquoise line, with the sunset and the far shore behind.
